signature.name: Beef karahi
signature.description: Slow-cooked on the fire, dark with tomato and finished with shredded ginger, green chilli and coriander. Serves two to three with bread.

signature.name: Chicken karahi
signature.description: Cooked on the bone, low and slow, until the gravy clings to the meat. The pot most tables order for dinner.

signature.name: Zinger burger
signature.description: A crispy fried chicken fillet with lettuce and mayo in a soft toasted bun, ketchup on the plate.

signature.name: Pizza
signature.description: Hand-stretched dough with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked until the edges blister. Basil on top.
